assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a painterly color texture atlas for low-poly tactical game environment obstacles. Create ONE landscape rectangular atlas divided EXACTLY into 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Each of the 6 rectangular panels must fill its entire cell to every edge: NO gutter, NO margins, NO labels, NO text, NO objects on blank backgrounds, no lighting highlights, no cast shadows, flat unlit albedo only. Coarse readable hand-painted brushstrokes, desaturated rural military storybook palette compatible with olive meadows and broadleaf trees, not photorealistic.
TOP ROW left to right: 1) very dark brown-green BLACKWATER BOG surface, layered murky peat-black water with irregular subtle ochre duckweed islands, only 10% floating vegetation, no large bright islands, readable as deep unsafe water; 2) saturated dark wet peat and moss, fibrous tangled broken roots and cracked soft mud, near-black brown with olive edges; 3) extremely tangled jungle vines and woody roots, dark olive and warm brown interwoven diagonal cords with tiny broad leaves, painterly surface pattern dense enough to suggest no opening.
BOTTOM ROW left to right: 4) interwoven temperate brambles, deep green bristle foliage with reddish-brown tangled branches and small pale thorns, compact dense brushwork; 5) dry straw-ochre thorn scrub, grey and brown interwoven crooked branches, sharp pale thorns, very sparse tiny faded sage leaves, dense tangled pattern; 6) rough broken trunk wood, long warm umber bark ridges and a few pale ochre splinters, no whole log silhouettes or circular trunk cross-sections.
Every panel must be a repeating texture-like material close-up with evenly distributed detail, no central focal object, no decorative frame, no white seams. Larger underlying value masses and fine painted marks, no sculpted-looking microgeometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art direction contact sheet for FIVE impassable biome terrain patches in a painterly isometric tactical game. Wide landscape illustration, 5 equal panels left to right, all same orthographic three-quarter angle and human scale, warm hand-painted low-poly storybook finish. Each panel shows a roughly 3 meter square dangerous terrain patch sitting flush in a larger square of ordinary local grass, not on a raised diorama pedestal. One small human-height anthro horse soldier at the front outside each patch shows scale, no weapons action. Keep paint detailed and shapes chunky/simple. Clearly recognizable safe empty grass surrounds the patch and none of the dangerous patches offers a walkable route across it.
Panel 1 title 'JUNGLE — ROOT TANGLE': waist-high impenetrable woven broad roots, low tangled vines and dense glossy broadleaf growth, olive jungle grass around it.
Panel 2 title 'TEMPERATE — BRAMBLE DEADFALL': two crisscross fallen trunks embedded in waist-high thorny brambles, ordinary meadow surround, obvious dense blocked ground.
Panel 3 title 'SNOW — WINDTHROW': multiple interlocked fallen conifer trunks and protruding broken branches, solid rounded snow drifts packed between them, winter grass around it.
Panel 4 title 'DRY — THORN THICKET': dense interlocked acacia-like thorn scrub, grey-brown branch forks with pale sharp thorns and sparse ochre leaves, dry golden grass surround; no desert cactus.
Panel 5 title 'WETLANDS — BLACKWATER BOG': a flat dark black-green peat-water depression with soft ragged peat banks, sparse floating scum, a few reeds and half-submerged roots at the margin; no dry stepping stones, no bridge, no walkable islands, damp green grass surround.
Use visible dark boundaries under foliage and ragged organic shapes to show where safe ground ends. This is terrain art for a game, no UI overlay, no red warning symbols, no photorealism. Balanced composition with each full patch visible and captions legible.
